message.text: The file `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` provides the complete current schema for a fresh SQLite installation.

q10.
store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql

`store/migrator.go` applies `LATEST.sql` on an uninitialized database. For SQLite that file is `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`, which contains the full current schema.
